AboutProject.title: Your Pet's Digital Life, All in One Place
AboutProject.subtitle: Everything you need to keep your pet healthy, organized, and connected with the best veterinary care.
AboutProject.archive_desc: Forget about lost certificates. Store tests, vaccinations, and prescriptions in the cloud — accessible anytime, anywhere.
AboutProject.passport_desc: Generate a complete pet health report in one click. Perfect for travel, boarding, or vet visits abroad.
AboutProject.security_desc: You decide who gets access to your pet's data: the vet, a relative, or a pet sitter. Share with a single QR code.

AboutPage.title: Everything About CareYour.Pet
AboutPage.subtitle: A complete guide to the platform: what it does, what's inside, and how owners, veterinarians, and clinics work with it.
AboutPage.what_body: CareYour.Pet is a single ecosystem for pet health. It turns scattered paper records and forgotten appointments into one digital card that connects the owner with trusted veterinary specialists. All medical history, routine care, and communication live in one place — accessible anywhere, on any device.

roles.title: Pet owner
roles.desc: Keeps the pet's medical card, vaccinations, weight, and visits in one place. Gets reminders, asks the AI assistant, and shares the card with a vet by QR code.

roles.title: Veterinarian
roles.desc: Creates patient cards before the owner registers, uses exam templates, issues invoices, and chats with owners in real time.

roles.title: Clinic
roles.desc: Gets a unified workspace: patients, team members, procedure templates, service catalog, and billing in a single dashboard.

features.title: Digital medical card
features.desc: EAV-based attributes, photos, and pedigree stored in a structured card for each pet.

features.title: Planboard
features.desc: Drag-and-drop planning for routine care and treatments day by day.

features.title: Calendar
features.desc: All events — vaccinations, visits, treatments — on a shared calendar.

features.title: AI assistant
features.desc: Ask questions about your pet and get streamed answers powered by DeepSeek.

features.title: Chat with a vet
features.desc: Real-time messaging between owner and veterinarian over WebSocket.

features.title: QR access
features.desc: Share a temporary read/write link to the pet's card, valid for one hour.

features.title: Invoices and payments
features.desc: Service catalog with taxes and discounts, and online invoice payment.

features.title: Reminders
features.desc: Flexible in-app and email notifications for upcoming events.

features.title: Find a vet
features.desc: Map of nearby clinics built on Leaflet.

AboutPage.how_owner_title: How to start as an owner
how_owner_steps: Create an account or try the demo.
Add your pet and fill in its digital card.
Track vaccinations, weight, and visits on the planboard and calendar.
Ask the AI assistant or chat with a veterinarian.
Share the card with a clinic by QR code when needed.
AboutPage.how_vet_title: How to start as a veterinarian
how_vet_steps: Register and submit your qualification for verification.
Create patient cards and use exam templates.
Set up your service catalog and issue invoices.
Chat with owners and manage your clinic team.
Invite owners to the platform and grow your practice.
